topic: Diffusing Capacity of the Lung for Carbon Monoxide
whyItFits: No open interpretive standard for DLCO was available. An office-spirometry abstract and a carbon-monoxide poisoning paper were rejected as off topic. Synopsis and MCQs were not written.
limitations: No open interpretive standard for DLCO was available. An office-spirometry abstract and a carbon-monoxide poisoning paper were rejected as off topic. Synopsis and MCQs were not written.
